evidence_commands: Docker Python 3.11 inline H6 pilot Ridge fit with source-derived residual/retransformation/variation metrics
Docker Python 3.11 inline H6 pilot Ridge fit with 40 seeded counterfactual plans and nuisance-design comparisons

source_findings.ridge_equation: log(Y_gt) = alpha + X_media_gt beta + Z_gt gamma + error_gt; one global alpha, pooled beta vector, supplied controls, no geo or week effects
source_findings.ridge_inverse: exp(mu_hat), with no Duan smearing or sigma^2/2 correction
source_findings.bayesian_comparator: geo-indexed alpha and beta posterior means; exp(mu + 0.5*sigma^2), research/diagnostic only
source_findings.canonical_delta_mu: mean(mu_plan) - mean(mu_baseline) from full-panel recursive counterfactual design matrices
source_findings.canonical_level_summary: row-level exp(mu) followed by mean, or mean of per-geo row-level exp(mu)
source_findings.replay_level_aggregation: row-level level prediction differences aggregated by declared mean, sum, or geo_mean_then_global_mean
source_findings.diagnostic_decomposition: additive log-scale channel contributions; explicitly not exact business value

nuisance_structure_comparison.warning: These are research comparisons on one H6 pilot world; lower prediction error does not establish causal or production superiority.

national_identification.interpretation: Exact national media is collinear with saturated week effects; structured time controls can only recover it through modeling assumptions rather than within-week identifying variation.

decision_invariance.interpretation: On this pilot and seeded plan set, ranking is effectively invariant; this does not establish invariance under heteroskedastic or misspecified future worlds.

analyses.audit_question: Does canonical full-panel Delta-mu select the same constrained allocation as an expected-level diagnostic objective?
candidate_specifications: existing level summary optimized with the same SLSQP constraint family
metric_definitions: decision regret=(level optimum-level value at Delta-mu allocation)/abs(level optimum)
limitations: The level objective was locally optimized with the repository's existing SLSQP method and produced a different allocation despite no measured regret on this surface; this is not broad certification.
No defensible production materiality threshold exists.

analyses.audit_question: Can replay consequence effects be isolated without changing replay contracts?
candidate_specifications: existing geo/time nuisance comparison and diagnostic global correction

preregistered_interpretation_bands.replay_relative_bias_gap: high <=2 percentage points; intermediate <=5 pp; material >5 pp

results.aggregation: row-level level differences under declared replay estimands

limitations: The controlled cells reuse the audit's existing deterministic H6 nuisance comparison; a fully isolated experiment-truth replay lift decomposition was not added because the repository has no single existing entry point that simultaneously swaps mean specification and retransformation.

analyses.audit_question: Does existing evidence support geo-varying media effects?
candidate_specifications: existing Bayesian H5 partial-pooling research comparator

preregistered_interpretation_bands.effect_recovery: descriptive only; no production bar preregistered

results.bayesian_partial_pooling: not executed: fixture-ready runtime lacks pymc

limitations: No apples-to-apples geo-varying comparison is claimed; adding an estimator or installing a new Bayesian runtime would exceed this correction's bounded evidence scope.

analyses.audit_question: What aggregation weighting is supported by the audited data?

results.sum_total: supported when KPI totals are requested

limitations: Weighting semantics are distinct from the rejected exp(mean(mu)) order defect; spend weighting is not treated as causal.

metrics.aggregation_semantics: channel allocation L1 normalized by twice total budget

recommendations.successor_milestone: bounded optimizer/hurdle certification across independent heteroskedastic worlds
semantic regression tests for declared aggregation modes

scope_limitations: H6 pilot is 20 geos by 52 weeks, not a production-scale certification.
The H6 generative truth includes geo-varying beta and seasonality, while the Ridge comparison uses a global intercept and pooled beta vector; the audit does not retrofit the model.
The empirical correction comparison is diagnostic and not a recommendation to apply a correction to residuals containing omitted structure.
No production optimizer, replay, or decision surface was modified.
